```text
latest projection for context
latest accepted projection for context
latest blocked projection for context
projection by execution
projection by step
projection by provider request
projection by compaction artifact
compaction artifact by root source part
claim ledger by compaction artifact
source links by raw event part
trace events by projection
operator reports by projection
```

These are audit access paths, not only runtime paths.

### Runtime query: latest accepted projection

Purpose:

```text
find the projection that was accepted for a context before provider rendering
```

Filters:

```text
contextId
status: accepted or rendered or dispatched or completed
createdAt descending
```

Required fields:

```text
projectionId
contextId
executionId
status
triggerReason
budgetSnapshot
validationStatus
createdAt
```

Why:

```text
the engine may need to inspect the latest accepted projection for replay, reporting, or continuation
```

### Runtime query: active blocked projection

Purpose:

```text
surface why a context cannot continue automatically
```

Filters:

```text
contextId
status: blocked or validation_failed
resolvedAt missing
createdAt descending
```

Required fields:

```text
projectionId
blockClass
failureCodes
blockedClaims
requiredRemediation
operatorReportId
createdAt
```

Why:

```text
blocked projection needs operator action, not silent retry
```

### Audit query: source part to compaction artifact

Purpose:

```text
answer which summaries relied on a raw part
```

Filters:

```text
sourcePartId
sourceLinkKind: root or direct
```

Required fields:

```text
sourcePartId
projectionSegmentId
compactionArtifactId
claimIds
projectionId
createdAt
```

Why:

```text
if a raw source is later found wrong or sensitive, operators need to find affected artifacts
```

### Audit query: claim to root source

Purpose:

```text
prove an operational claim or explain why it was blocked
```

Filters:

```text
claimId
compactionArtifactId
```

Required fields:

```text
claimText
claimClass
authorityClass
sourceIds
rootSourcePartIds
validationResult
failureCode
tenantScope
redactionState
```

Why:

```text
claim proof is the audit core of compaction
```

### Audit query: projection timeline

Purpose:

```text
show all projection lifecycle transitions for a context or execution
```

Filters:

```text
contextId or executionId
createdAt ascending
```

Required fields:

```text
projectionId
previousStatus
nextStatus
transitionReason
traceEventId
actor
createdAt
```

Why:

```text
operators need to see how context moved from source collection to accepted, blocked, dispatched, or superseded
```

### Audit query: provider request provenance

Purpose:

```text
link a provider call back to the exact rendered projection
```

Filters:

```text
providerRequestId
renderedInputHash
projectionId
```

Required fields:

```text
projectionId
renderedInputHash
provider
model
messageCount
toolCount
inputTokenEstimate
actualPromptTokens
providerUsageRaw
```

Why:

```text
usage, cost, overflow, and model output must be explainable from projection state
```

### Query: migration report source coverage

Purpose:

```text
assemble final migration report evidence
```

Filters:

```text
contextId
migrationStage
status: accepted or blocked
```

Required fields:

```text
stage
mustKeepCoverage
blockedClaims
sourceLinkCount
operatorReportId
verificationState
createdAt
```

Why:

```text
final reports should not reconstruct evidence from prose summaries
```

### Candidate index fields

Projection entity:

```text
contextId
executionId
status
triggerReason
createdAt
updatedAt
supersededByProjectionId
```

Projection segment entity:

```text
projectionId
segmentKind
authorityClass
tenantScope
tokenEstimate
sourceDepth
```

Source link entity:

```text
projectionId
projectionSegmentId
compactionArtifactId
claimId
sourceEventId
sourceItemId
sourceStepId
sourcePartId
rootSourcePartId
sourceKind
tenantScope
```

Compaction artifact entity:

```text
projectionId
artifactKind
validationStatus
sourceDepth
maxSummaryDepth
createdAt
```

Claim ledger entity:

```text
compactionArtifactId
claimClass
authorityClass
validationResult
failureCode
tenantScope
redactionState
```

Retrieval result entity:

```text
projectionId
queryId
provider
sourceScope
score
tenantScope
selected
```

Rule activation entity:

```text
projectionId
ruleId
authorityClass
scope
activationMode
selected
```

### Retention query classes

Hot runtime:

```text
latest projection
active blocked projection
latest rendered input preview
current operator report
```

Warm audit:

```text
claim ledger
source links
trace events
usage calibration records
recursive lineage
```

Cold archive:

```text
old accepted projections
obsolete summaries
large raw source snapshots
old rendered previews
```

Never delete automatically without approved retention policy:

```text
raw event_parts
technical-leader approvals
migration execution results
verification results
operator reports for production migrations
```

### Storage pressure controls

Projection artifacts can grow.

Controls:

```text
store hashes for large rendered previews
store full rendered preview only for selected audit modes
store external large artifacts by reference
store source links as structured rows, not repeated prose
deduplicate root source links across recursive compactions
compress cold artifacts at storage layer only after approval
```

The model-facing context should never depend on whether cold storage compression exists.

### Consistency checks

Periodic verification queries should detect:

```text
accepted projection without source links
compaction artifact without claim ledger
claim ledger accepted claim without source
blocked projection without operator report
rendered provider dispatch without projection id
usage record without rendered input hash
recursive artifact without root source coverage
source link crossing tenant scope
```

### Query performance risks

Risk:

```text
source-link fanout can be high for long migration sessions
```

Mitigation proposal:

```text
source links should be normalized and queryable by sourcePartId, projectionId, and compactionArtifactId
```

Risk:

```text
operator reports may duplicate structured data
```

Mitigation proposal:

```text
operator report stores human-readable rendering plus ids for structured query records
```

Risk:

```text
retrieval results can be noisy and numerous
```

Mitigation proposal:

```text
store selected retrieval results separately from candidates, and retain candidates by approved policy
```

### Minimal first slice

If schema work is approved later, the minimal storage slice should still avoid overreach.

Possible first storage slice:

```text
projection trace payloads only
projection id
status
budget snapshot
selected segment summary
blocked reason
```

Not in first storage slice unless approved:

```text
full first-class projection entities
claim ledger rows
retrieval result rows
rule activation rows
provider-native compact state rows
```

### Target storage slice

Target state:

```text
projection entities
projection segment entities
source link entities
compaction artifact entities
claim ledger records
retrieval query/result entities
rule activation entities
usage calibration records
operator reports
```

Target property:

```text
every model-visible compacted claim can be traced to root source material through queryable records
```

### Recommendation

Design projection storage around audit access paths first and runtime convenience second.

Reason:

```text
runtime projection is only safe if future operators can prove what happened
```

## Consumer contract risk by package entrypoint

Status: proposal only.

The `@ekairos/events` package exposes multiple entrypoints. A future compaction implementation should treat each entrypoint as a public contract surface.

This section is based on local package export inspection and does not approve code changes.

### Observed package export anchors

Package export map:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\package.json:20

Root source exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\index.ts:1

Context facade exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\context.ts:1

Reactor facade exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\context.reactor.ts:1

Runtime facade exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\runtime.ts:35

React facade exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\react.ts:3

Instant store exports:

@C:\ekairos-projects\workspace\ekairos-base\packages\events\src\stores\instant.store.ts:23

### Entrypoint: root package

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
general context APIs
actions
events
store contracts
runtime helpers
parts
tool calls
stream contracts
```

Compaction risk:

```text
adding projection types may expand public API
changing existing context types can break direct imports
changing event item semantics can break UI and runtime consumers
```

Recommended stance:

```text
new projection types should be exported intentionally
existing raw event contracts should remain clearly raw
do not overload existing ContextItem as compacted projection
```

### Entrypoint: schema

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/schema
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
Instant schema/domain entity definitions
```

Compaction risk:

```text
adding first-class projection entities changes schema consumers
query code may need new indexes and links
schema migration requires approved plan
```

Recommended stance:

```text
schema changes require explicit technical-leader approval
projection schema should be breaking and intentional
trace-only first slice can delay schema changes
```

### Entrypoint: domain

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/domain
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
eventsDomain for reusable domain registration
```

Compaction risk:

```text
new projection entities affect domain migration plans
downstream apps must consume updated domain package before querying new records
```

Recommended stance:

```text
domain additions should ship with migration documentation and validation report
```

### Entrypoint: runtime

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/runtime
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
runtime env registration
durable workflow configuration
step stream read/write helpers
```

Compaction risk:

```text
projection lifecycle may add new trace events
blocked projection may affect durable workflow status
rendered projection ids may need to flow through runtime helpers
```

Recommended stance:

```text
runtime behavior changes require explicit workflow semantics approval
blocked projection status should be documented before implementation
```

### Entrypoint: reactor

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/reactor
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
reactor params
reactor output contract
provider-neutral action specs
```

Compaction risk:

```text
target design breaks reactor input contract
reactors may receive projection-aware input rather than raw event arrays
provider-specific rendering may move out of reactor implementation
```

Recommended stance:

```text
this is the highest-risk public contract break
approve reactor contract ADR before code
provide direct migration notes for reactor authors
```

### Entrypoint: codex

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/codex
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
Codex-oriented context helpers and action wiring
```

Compaction risk:

```text
Codex-style tool loops may depend on raw event expansion
remote app-server or sandbox flows may need rendered projection metadata
tool approval gates must remain visible after compaction
```

Recommended stance:

```text
Codex consumer changes should validate real tool loop behavior after package beta release
```

### Entrypoint: react

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/react
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
React hooks and UI conversion helpers for context events and streams
```

Compaction risk:

```text
operator reports may need UI surfaces
blocked projection statuses may need display states
source-link audit view may need new data shape
```

Recommended stance:

```text
UI additions should show projection state without hiding raw event history
```

### Entrypoint: instant

Entrypoint:

```text
@ekairos/events/instant
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
InstantStore and document parsing/store helpers
```

Compaction risk:

```text
projection queries may belong in store
itemsToModelMessages currently converts stored items to model messages
future projection-aware rendering may change store responsibilities
```

Recommended stance:

```text
do not put provider-specific compaction inside InstantStore
store can expose raw source retrieval and projection record persistence after approval
```

### Entrypoint: mcp and oidc

Entrypoints:

```text
@ekairos/events/mcp
@ekairos/events/oidc
```

Likely consumer expectation:

```text
MCP handler/auth integration
OIDC helpers
```

Compaction risk:

```text
lower direct impact unless context tools expose projection state or operator reports through MCP
```

Recommended stance:

```text
keep out of first implementation slice unless a consumer explicitly requires projection inspection through MCP or OIDC-gated routes
```

### Consumer migration notes

For a future breaking implementation, migration notes should include:

```text
old import surface
new import surface
old reactor params
new reactor params
projection status handling
blocked projection handling
trace event additions
operator report availability
schema/domain changes if any
test commands run
downstream validation target
```

### Release classification

Docs-only research:

```text
no package release
no branch creation
no push
```

Projection contracts only:

```text
beta or major-prep release depending on approved public type exposure
```

Reactor contract break:

```text
major or beta with explicit downstream migration
```

Schema/domain changes:

```text
approved migration plan required before release
```

Provider-native compaction adapter:

```text
provider-specific beta validation required
```

### Downstream validation route after approval

Future reusable package behavior change should follow the project integration loop.

Proposed route:

```text
implement approved package slice
validate locally
push approved branch or development flow only after instruction
wait for package publish workflow if used
verify beta package version
update downstream integration app to beta
validate product behavior with real context flow
```

For Codex reactor or sandbox-adjacent changes, the project rules require real validation rather than mocked sandbox behavior.

### Consumer contract recommendation

Treat compaction as a package-level public contract change, not as an internal optimization.

Reason:

```text
context shape, reactor params, trace events, UI states, and schema records are all downstream-visible
```

## Model visibility policy by source class

Status: design proposal.

Context compaction is partly a selection problem:

```text
what should the model see?
```

It is also a visibility problem:

```text
what is allowed to be model-visible at all?
```

This section proposes source-class visibility rules for Ekairos projection.

### Visibility modes

Raw visible:

```text
source content can be included directly in provider-facing messages
```

Structured visible:

```text
source can be rendered as structured provider content or structured text with source ids
```

Summary visible:

```text
source can be summarized after claim-ledger validation
```

Metadata-only:

```text
model may know that source exists but not see source content
```

Retrieval-only:

```text
source is stored outside the prompt and may be retrieved under policy
```

Never visible:

```text
source cannot be sent to the model
```

Blocked pending approval:

```text
source requires explicit approval or remediation before visibility decision
```

### Source class: current user request

Default visibility:

```text
raw visible
```

Reason:

```text
the current user request is the active intent
```

Rules:

```text
must remain final active intent
must not be summarized while active
must override older assistant plans
```

Exception:

```text
if current user request includes secret material, redaction policy applies before provider dispatch
```

### Source class: project and system instructions

Default visibility:

```text
raw visible or structured visible at highest authority
```

Rules:

```text
must retain authority
must not be converted into assistant summary
must not be merged with lower-authority memory
```

Blocked state:

```text
renderer cannot preserve authority for target provider
```

### Source class: technical-leader approval or denial

Default visibility:

```text
raw visible while operational
summary visible after no longer active, with source links
```

Rules:

```text
approval state must be exact
denial must be preserved as denial
approval source must be citeable
```

Never allowed:

```text
infer approval from assistant plan
infer approval from absence of objection
summarize denial as resolved
```

### Source class: local code fact

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with file anchors
```

Raw visible when:

```text
small snippet is required for reasoning
current task is code analysis
file does not contain secrets
```

Retrieval-only when:

```text
large file can be re-read
only symbol existence matters
source is old background
```

Rules:

```text
file anchor must remain available for behavior-affecting claim
stale file inspection must be marked stale after relevant edits
```

### Source class: package scripts and command outputs

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with exact result fields
```

Raw visible when:

```text
short command output is needed for diagnosis
failure text is needed
```

Summary visible fields:

```text
command
exit code
pass/fail
important counts
important error lines
timestamp
```

Forbidden:

```text
drop failure state
convert failed test into passed test
omit exit code for operational claim
```

### Source class: verbose grep/search output

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible or retrieval-only
```

Rules:

```text
preserve selected anchors
omit repeated noise
record query pattern
record no-match result when behavior-affecting
```

Raw visible when:

```text
output is small and exact match set matters
```

### Source class: tool call inputs

Default visibility:

```text
structured visible while recent or pending
summary visible after completed if not sensitive
```

Rules:

```text
tool name must be preserved
tool call id must be preserved
input redaction state must be known
approval metadata must be preserved
```

Blocked state:

```text
input contains secret and redaction has not run
```

### Source class: tool results

Default visibility:

```text
structured visible while operational
summary visible after claim-ledger validation
```

Rules:

```text
success/failure exact state is must-keep
partial results must remain partial
error messages should be preserved when relevant
large successful outputs can be summarized with counts and checksums
```

Never allowed:

```text
summarize failed result as success
drop tool result while keeping tool call
include result without matching call
```

### Source class: migration datasets

Default visibility:

```text
metadata-only or retrieval-only
```

Raw visible only when:

```text
dataset is synthetic
dataset is small
tenant scope is approved
no secrets or sensitive fields
explicit task requires raw sample
```

Summary visible fields:

```text
dataset name
org/app scope
filters
row count
checksum
sample id list when safe
artifact reference
redaction status
```

Never allowed:

```text
raw production secrets
raw sensitive PII without approved policy
cross-org blended rows
```

### Source class: admin tokens and credentials

Default visibility:

```text
never visible
```

Allowed model-visible substitute:

```text
credential exists
credential missing
credential redacted
permission check passed or failed
```

Rules:

```text
actual credential value never enters summary
actual credential value never enters rendered preview
actual credential value never enters provider input
```

### Source class: schema dry-run output

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with structured pass/fail and source links
```

Raw visible when:

```text
small error output is needed to diagnose schema issue
```

Must keep:

```text
app id
environment
pass/fail
warnings
errors
timestamp
schema version or source commit when available
```

Forbidden:

```text
omit failed app
summarize warning as success
reuse stale dry-run after schema edit
```

### Source class: transaction plans

Default visibility:

```text
metadata-only plus summary visible
```

Raw visible only when:

```text
synthetic or approved
small representative excerpt
no sensitive values
```

Must keep:

```text
target org/app
operation count
operation classes
idempotency key strategy
approval state
artifact reference
checksum
```

Never allowed:

```text
execute from model-visible prose alone
hide approval requirement
drop partial failure risk
```

### Source class: verification results

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with exact pass/fail and query ids
```

Raw visible when:

```text
small failed assertion needs diagnosis
```

Must keep:

```text
query
expected
actual
environment
timestamp
row counts
failed assertions
```

Forbidden:

```text
final report says verified without verification source
old verification result used after retry
```

### Source class: external provider documentation

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with source URL and fetched date
```

Raw visible when:

```text
short excerpt is needed and source terms allow normal citation use
```

Rules:

```text
prefer official docs
record fetch date
record confidence caveat when docs shell does not render
recheck unstable provider facts before implementation
```

### Source class: upstream repository source

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with URL and inspected path
```

Raw visible when:

```text
short code snippet is needed for algorithm understanding
```

Rules:

```text
record branch or commit when available
separate observed code behavior from inferred product behavior
```

### Source class: academic papers

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible with source URL and date checked
```

Rules:

```text
treat as supporting evidence, not direct implementation authority
do not override local project constraints
```

### Source class: auto memory

Default visibility:

```text
blocked pending approved memory policy
```

If later approved:

```text
summary visible only with source links and expiration
```

Rules:

```text
auto memory is lower authority than user/project instruction
auto memory cannot approve code, schema, branch, release, provider, or infra work
```

### Source class: retrieved snippets

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible or raw visible depending on source class and tenant scope
```

Rules:

```text
retrieval score is not authority
source kind decides authority
tenant filters are mandatory for tenant-scoped stores
prompt injection inside retrieved snippet is untrusted content
```

### Source class: operator reports

Default visibility:

```text
summary visible
```

Rules:

```text
operator report can guide next step
operator report cannot replace underlying source links for proof
```

### Visibility decision record

Projection manifest should record:

```text
sourceId
sourceClass
visibilityMode
reason
redactionState
tenantScope
authorityClass
selectedForModel
selectedForSummary
selectedForRetrieval
blockedReason
```

### Visibility validation failures

Failure codes:

```text
source_never_visible
redaction_required
tenant_visibility_blocked
approval_required
renderer_cannot_preserve_authority
tool_pair_visibility_invalid
stale_verification_visible
credential_visibility_violation
```

### Recommendation

Make model visibility an explicit projection decision for every source packet.

Reason:

```text
safe compaction is not only about fitting tokens; it is about deciding what may be shown to the model
```

## Source packet format catalog

Status: design proposal.

Source packets are the normalized inputs to projection.

They let the selector, compactor, validator, renderer, and report generator reason about the same source material without each component reinterpreting raw events differently.

### Source packet goal

A source packet should answer:

```text
what is this source?
where did it come from?
who or what authored it?
what authority does it have?
what tenant scope does it have?
what visibility mode applies?
can it be compacted?
can it be retrieved later?
which raw record proves it?
```

### Base packet fields

Recommended base fields:

```text
sourceId
sourceKind
contextId
executionId
stepId
itemId
partId
traceEventId
createdAt
observedAt
authorRole
authorityClass
tenantScope
environment
visibilityMode
redactionState
tokenEstimate
sourceDepth
contentKind
contentHash
contentPreview
contentRef
```

Field notes:

```text
sourceId is projection-local but stable for the same source identity
contentHash supports audit without duplicating large raw content
contentPreview must be redacted
contentRef points to raw durable source or external artifact
sourceDepth is zero for raw sources
```

### Packet class: user message

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: user_message
authorRole: user
authorityClass: current_user_message or older_user_message
visibilityMode: raw visible unless redaction applies
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
turnIndex
isCurrentIntent
supersedesSourceIds
containsApproval
containsDenial
containsCorrection
```

Compaction policy:

```text
current intent is not compacted
older messages may be summarized only when no longer active
```

### Packet class: project instruction

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: project_instruction
authorRole: system_or_project
authorityClass: project_instruction
visibilityMode: raw visible or structured visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
instructionScope
appliesToPath
appliesToTask
priority
```

Compaction policy:

```text
never summarize into assistant voice
never merge with memory
```

### Packet class: local file anchor

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: local_file
authorRole: repository
authorityClass: local_repository_source
visibilityMode: summary visible or raw visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
absolutePath
line
column
gitStatus
contentHash
inspectedAt
```

Compaction policy:

```text
include exact anchor for behavior-affecting claims
use retrieval-only for large files
mark stale after relevant edit
```

### Packet class: command result

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: command_result
authorRole: tool
authorityClass: local_tool_result
visibilityMode: summary visible or raw visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
command
workingDirectory
exitCode
durationMs
stdoutHash
stderrHash
stdoutPreview
stderrPreview
timestamp
```

Compaction policy:

```text
pass/fail and exit code are must-keep for operational claims
large output may be summarized with count and important lines
```

### Packet class: action call

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: action_call
authorRole: assistant_or_model
authorityClass: model_generated_action
visibilityMode: structured visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
actionName
actionRef
providerPartId
inputHash
inputRedactionState
approvalRequired
approvalState
dangerClass
```

Compaction policy:

```text
pending actions are protected
completed actions can be summarized only with paired result
```

### Packet class: action result

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: action_result
authorRole: tool
authorityClass: local_tool_result
visibilityMode: structured visible while operational
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
actionName
actionRef
providerPartId
status
outputKind
outputHash
errorMessage
resultRedactionState
pairedCallSourceId
```

Compaction policy:

```text
status is must-keep
failed result remains failed
large success result can be summarized with source links
```

### Packet class: compaction artifact

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: compaction_artifact
authorRole: compactor
authorityClass: assistant_summary_with_sources
visibilityMode: summary visible
sourceDepth: greater than 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
compactionArtifactId
claimLedgerId
rootSourceIds
maxSummaryDepth
validationStatus
failureCodes
```

Compaction policy:

```text
may be used only if validation accepted
active operational claims require root-source refresh
```

### Packet class: retrieval result

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: retrieval_result
authorRole: retrieval_provider
authorityClass: derived_from_source
visibilityMode: depends on underlying source class
sourceDepth: 0 or derived
```

Required metadata:

```text
retrievalQueryId
retrievalProvider
score
sourceScope
underlyingSourceKind
tenantFilter
selected
```

Compaction policy:

```text
score is not authority
underlying source class determines visibility and authority
```

### Packet class: rule activation

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: rule_activation
authorRole: rule_engine
authorityClass: project_instruction or user_instruction or lower depending on rule source
visibilityMode: structured visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
ruleId
ruleSource
ruleScope
activationMode
conflictState
selected
```

Compaction policy:

```text
active rules should be rendered separately from summaries
conflicting rules block or require authority resolution
```

### Packet class: memory record

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: memory_record
authorRole: memory_engine
authorityClass: memory_low_authority unless explicitly promoted
visibilityMode: blocked pending approved memory policy
sourceDepth: derived
```

Required metadata:

```text
memoryId
sourceIds
extractedAt
expiresAt
promotionState
confidence
```

Compaction policy:

```text
not included in first implementation slice
cannot override project or current user instructions
```

### Packet class: external documentation

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: external_documentation
authorRole: external_source
authorityClass: official_docs or upstream_source or secondary_source
visibilityMode: summary visible
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
url
publisher
fetchedAt
retrievalMethod
confidenceCaveat
```

Compaction policy:

```text
official docs preferred
date-sensitive facts require recheck before implementation
```

### Packet class: migration artifact

Fields:

```text
sourceKind: migration_artifact
authorRole: migration_tool
authorityClass: migration_evidence
visibilityMode: metadata-only, summary visible, or retrieval-only
sourceDepth: 0
```

Required metadata:

```text
artifactKind
orgId
appId
environment
artifactHash
rowCount
createdAt
redactionState
approvalState
```

Compaction policy:

```text
raw artifact stays outside prompt unless explicitly approved
summary must preserve counts, scope, and failure state
```

### Packet normalization invariants

Every packet:

```text
has sourceId
has sourceKind
has authorityClass
has visibilityMode
has redactionState
has tenantScope or explicit none
has stable source pointer
```

No packet:

```text
stores raw secret preview
uses retrieval score as authority
loses action call/result pairing
claims approval without source
```

### Packet-to-segment mapping

Selector maps packets into projection segments.

Mapping examples:

```text
current user message -> protected recent segment
project instruction -> protected authority segment
large old grep result -> compressible segment
retrieved source snippet -> retrieval segment
admin token record -> metadata-only blocked source
validated compaction artifact -> compacted segment
```

### Packet test fixtures

Fixture SP1: current user correction.

```text
packet: user_message
containsCorrection: true
isCurrentIntent: true
expected: protected and raw visible
```

Fixture SP2: credential command output.

```text
packet: command_result
redactionState: unknown
expected: blocked pending redaction
```

Fixture SP3: action result failure.

```text
packet: action_result
status: failed
expected: protected while operational
```

Fixture SP4: retrieved tenant snippet.

```text
packet: retrieval_result
tenantFilter: missing
expected: tenant_visibility_blocked
```

Fixture SP5: validated summary.

```text
packet: compaction_artifact
validationStatus: accepted
rootSourceIds: present
expected: summary visible
```

### Recommendation

Define source packets before implementing compaction algorithms.

Reason:

```text
selection, validation, rendering, reporting, and audit all depend on the same normalized source metadata
```

## Worked numeric budget ledger examples

Status: design proposal.

Token budgets should be visible as ledgers, not hidden estimates.

This section gives concrete budget examples. Numbers are illustrative and must be calibrated with provider usage before implementation.

### Ledger fields

Budget ledger should include:

```text
modelWindowTokens
systemTokens
ruleTokens
recentRawTokens
protectedTokens
compressibleRawTokens
compactionArtifactTokens
retrievalTokens
toolSchemaTokens
providerOverheadTokens
outputReserveTokens
safetyMarginTokens
estimatedInputTokens
estimatedTotalRequiredTokens
headroomTokens
decision
```

Decision values:

```text
raw_fits
compact_old_history
reduce_tool_surface
retrieve_instead_of_inline
block
```

### Example 1: 32k planning turn

Scenario:

```text
migration planning
no execution approval
many old exploration messages
small tool profile
model window: 32000
```

Raw estimate:

```text
modelWindowTokens: 32000
systemTokens: 2500
ruleTokens: 1200
recentRawTokens: 6500
protectedTokens: 3000
compressibleRawTokens: 21000
toolSchemaTokens: 3500
providerOverheadTokens: 800
outputReserveTokens: 5000
safetyMarginTokens: 2500
```

Raw total:

```text
estimatedInputTokens: 38500
estimatedTotalRequiredTokens: 46000
headroomTokens: -14000
decision: compact_old_history
```

Compacted estimate:

```text
systemTokens: 2500
ruleTokens: 1200
recentRawTokens: 6500
protectedTokens: 3000
compactionArtifactTokens: 4200
retrievalTokens: 900
toolSchemaTokens: 2200
providerOverheadTokens: 800
outputReserveTokens: 5000
safetyMarginTokens: 2500
```

Compacted total:

```text
estimatedInputTokens: 21300
estimatedTotalRequiredTokens: 28800
headroomTokens: 3200
decision: accepted
```

Key lesson:

```text
for small windows, old exploration must be compacted and tool surface must be scoped
```

### Example 2: 32k protected overflow

Scenario:

```text
current user request plus approvals, tenant matrix, recent failed dry-run, and required tool results are already too large
```

Estimate:

```text
modelWindowTokens: 32000
systemTokens: 2500
ruleTokens: 1200
recentRawTokens: 12500
protectedTokens: 13500
toolSchemaTokens: 2500
providerOverheadTokens: 800
outputReserveTokens: 5000
safetyMarginTokens: 2500
```

Total:

```text
estimatedInputTokens: 33000
estimatedTotalRequiredTokens: 40500
headroomTokens: -8500

```

Why not summarize:

```text
protected material is active and cannot be safely summarized
```

Possible remediation:

```text
switch approved larger model
split migration by organization
ask operator to choose narrower stage
store large active artifact outside prompt and include verified metadata only
```

Key lesson:

```text
blocking is a valid projection outcome
```

### Example 3: 128k migration dry-run analysis

Scenario:

```text
schema dry-run analysis
medium tool profile
moderate old history
model window: 128000
```

Raw estimate:

### Example 4: 128k tool surface pressure

Scenario:

```text
same dry-run task but all tools are registered
```

Estimate:


### Example 6: 200k retrieval-first source catalog

Scenario:

```text
research session with many external sources and local anchors
only some sources are relevant to current implementation approval packet
```

Estimate:

```text
modelWindowTokens: 200000
systemTokens: 4000
ruleTokens: 2500
```

Total:

```text

estimatedTotalRequiredTokens: 155000
headroomTokens: 45000

```

Adjustment:

```text
inline only active source summaries and source catalog

preserve source URLs and local file anchors in claim ledger
```

Adjusted total:

```text
estimatedInputTokens: 72000
estimatedTotalRequiredTokens: 102000
```
